projects.title: LexiQuest — English Learning Game
projects.summary: An English vocabulary adventure game where players clear levels by matching words, beating timed quizzes, and unlocking story chapters. Built to make language practice feel like play, not homework.
highlights: Designed level flow, scoring, and reward loops for teens
Crafted character art direction and in-game UI screens
Playtested with classmates and tightened difficulty curves

projects.title: Aether — Mobile App Interface
projects.summary: A full mobile app UI concept with dark-blue visual system, smooth onboarding, and clean navigation. Focused on hierarchy, micro-interactions, and a look that feels premium — not childish.
highlights: Mapped user flows from splash to core features
Built a reusable component system in Figma
Delivered high-fidelity screens ready for handoff

projects.title: Studio Site — Personal Brand Web
projects.summary: A university-application portfolio site with a steel-blue atmosphere, bold typography, and project storytelling. Designed so admissions reviewers get the vibe in the first scroll.
highlights: Art-directed layout, type, and color for a cool mature tone
Shipped a responsive Next.js front end

projects.title: PhraseRun — Speaking Challenge Mini-App
projects.summary: A fast-paced English speaking drill app concept: listen, repeat, race the clock. Visuals lean neon-on-navy arcade energy so practice sessions feel competitive and addictive.
highlights: Defined core loop: prompt → speak → score → streak
Designed HUD, progress rings, and streak badges
Packaged pitch deck + mockups for school showcase
